Key features:
- Large, irregular necrotic lesions (brown/gray-brown)
- Yellow-tan transitional border around dead tissue
- Lesions on the leaf blade, not fruit or stem
- Pattern spreading inward from edges

This points to **Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka** (large coalescing necrotic lesions on leaf) or possibly **Cordana_Leaf_Spot**. Let me check one reference image.

The reference image matches the test image very well:
- Both show large irregular necrotic areas (brown/gray) on banana leaves
- Both have a prominent yellow-to-brown transitional zone
- Same pattern of extensive leaf tissue death with yellow margins

This is a strong match for **Yellow_And_Black_Sigatoka**.
